question: Does the version-6-to-8 migration and freshness contract sufficiently preserve existing databases and legacy portable archive reads to land this store-wide change?
rationale: Tests and checks substantially reduce risk, but the patch changes persistent ordering semantics across canonical and derived state, so acceptance of the upgrade contract requires store-owner judgment.

options.title: Complete store-owner review
options.body: Confirm the migration floor, legacy read-only fallback, and every freshness consumer against representative existing stores before merging.

options.title: Keep the branch draft
options.body: Leave the PR draft until maintainers are prepared to own the new persistent ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Complete store-owner review
recommendation.body: Confirm the migration floor, legacy read-only fallback, and every freshness consumer against representative existing stores before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent released portable-store and migration work is the strongest current-main ownership signal for the compatibility decision.
